name: YYLO Skills
summary: Eight reusable agent skills for the YYLO agent workflow: Ledger task management and planning, project discovery, wiki and artifact records, and benchmark runs.
description: YYLO Skills is the canonical, independently versioned source for eight reusable agent skills used by YYLO CLI, YYLO Ledger and YYLO Benchmark. Each skill lives in its own skills/<name>/ folder with a SKILL.md and a README.

The skills cover the workflow end to end: Ledger task and record management (ledger-tasks-yylo), planning a Product Development Requirement into implementation-sized tasks (plan-ledger-tasks-yylo), inspecting a product's architecture before changing it (understand-project-yylo), durable wiki and artifact records (wiki-yylo, artifact-yylo), validated workflow records (workflow-yylo), reviewed benchmark cases and evaluations (benchmark-yylo) and the Ralph execution loop for one assigned task (ralph-loop-yylo).

Every canonical slug ends in -yylo. The repository installs with the open skills CLI: npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills installs all skills, and passing --skill wiki-yylo installs one. The README asks you to review skill instructions and scripts before installing them. It is a community project, not made or endorsed by Anthropic.
